newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek General Infrastructure fund assets up 54pct.
newsitem.headline: Greek General Infrastructure fund assets up 54pct.

text.p: General Construction & Infrastructure fund said its assets under management rose 54.3 percent exceeding 3.1 billion drachmas from 2.0 billion in the beginning of 1997.
Its year-to-date return based on February 24 closing prices is 40.36 percent.
The mutual fund, managed by Hambros Hellenic Fund Management, is 90 percent invested in construction sector shares.
Its largest holdings include Alte, Hellenic Technodomiki, Terna, OTE telecom, Edrasi, Titan, Technodomi and Aegek, it said.
Construction shares rallied on Monday with the sectoral index gaining 7.95 percent, warming to strong expectations that Athens will be among the candidate cities to host the 2004 Olympic Games.
